reviewScope: Complete physical source review of opcode classification, AST/IR materialization policies, type-index and function ownership preparation, ordered normalization, move events and coroutine tables. Does not close phase or runtime parity.
reviewNotes: Socket/file/completion/raw Arena opcode families preserve gaps and distinguish Task, Result and Unit. Targetless builtin conversion and runtime aliases retain explicit semantic admission.
Interpolation membership excludes fragment-owned nodes while canonical retained roots remain ordinary values. Shared default/contextual/control shape policies feed entry and named functions.

Recursive type projection and nearest-ancestor indexes preserve first-distance ties; function terminal roots choose latest top-level source child. Frozen tables are borrowed across source lowering and output IR edges are relocated once.

Move events distinguish declared move arguments, awaited Task ownership, container insertion, fixed-storage copies, member paths, borrowed block roles and ownership regions. Function declaration indexes retain ascending IR order.

Coroutine suspension points bind to concrete materializations; states follow source positions, active lexical bindings and pending temporary dependencies control spill sets, consumed Tasks are excluded and owned slots are destroyed in reverse order.

Review concern, not reproduced defect: arrayCapacityHint encodes capacity+1000000 in Int. Values near Int32 maximum may wrap; inspect CSharp capacity contract and actual LLVM without executing huge allocations before deciding any change.
